meta.description: Hardware facts per Lenovo server/HCI platform, paraphrased from Lenovo Press product guides.
meta.as_of_note: as_of 2026-09 = re-checked against the guide PDF; 2026-07 = carried from earlier guide research, not re-checked. Guides change: confirm against the current guide before quoting.

fields.mtms: CTO base model numbers (MTMs) the platform ships under
fields.machine_types: 4-character machine types -> warranty/variant note when the guide gives one
fields.hci_min_cpus: minimum CPUs for an HCI node when the guide states one, else null
fields.drives.max_front_bays_*: largest FRONT bay count in that form factor (rear/middle bays add to the chassis total)

platforms.name: ThinkSystem SR630 V3
platforms.cpu: 4th Gen (Sapphire Rapids) or 5th Gen (Emerald Rapids) Intel Xeon Scalable

memory.notes: 5600 MT/s at 1 DPC with 5th Gen Xeon; 4800 MT/s at 2 DPC or with 4th Gen Xeon.

options: Up to 4x 3.5-inch, or 12x 2.5-inch (10 front + 2 rear), or 16x EDSFF hot-swap
3.5-inch limited to 4 front bays (1U); rear bays are 2.5-inch only (2x SAS/SATA or 2x 7mm SATA)

pcie.notes: 3 rear (2x PCIe 5.0 + 1x PCIe 4.0) and 2 front; front riser only in specific front-bay configurations.

platforms.name: ThinkSystem SR630 V4

machine_types.7DK1: 3 year warranty, Neptune Core liquid cooled

platforms.cpu: Intel Xeon 6 6700P/6500P-series (Granite Rapids, P-core) or 6700E-series (Sierra Forest, E-core)

memory.notes: RDIMM 6400 MT/s at 1 DPC, 5200 at 2 DPC; MRDIMM up to 8000 MT/s at 1 DPC only.

options: Front: 10x 2.5-inch NVMe, AnyBay, or SAS/SATA mixes; 8x 2.5-inch NVMe or SAS/SATA; 16x E3.S 1T; 8x E3.S 2T; 8x E3.S 1T + 4x E3.S 2T
Rear: 2x 2.5-inch NVMe or SAS/SATA (12x 2.5-inch total)
M.2: 2x front/rear hot-swap M.2 bays or internal M.2 module
Up to 12x NVMe drives, all direct-connected
drives.notes: No 3.5-inch drive bays (change from SR630 V3).

pcie.notes: All PCIe 5.0, all at the rear; 2 OCP 3.0 slots (x8 or x16).

psu.notes: 80 PLUS Platinum/Titanium; 800W, 1300W, 2000W AC. All support 230V, some also 115V. HVDC and -48V DC options exist.

platforms.name: ThinkSystem ST650 V3

memory.notes: All 32 slots need two processors. 5600 MT/s only at 1 DPC with 5th Gen Xeon; 4800 (5th Gen) / 4400 (4th Gen) at 2 DPC.

options: Up to 32x 2.5-inch hot-swap (max 24x NVMe) plus 2x 5.25-inch media bays, OR up to 16x 3.5-inch hot-swap
The 2.5-inch and 3.5-inch chassis configurations differ

platforms.name: ThinkSystem SR675 V3

memory.notes: 4800 MT/s with EPYC 9004; 6400 MT/s with EPYC 9005.

options: 2.5-inch or EDSFF only; drive/slot maxima depend on the base model

SXM model: up to 4x 2.5-inch

platforms.name: ThinkAgile HX630 V4
platforms.cpu: Intel Xeon 6 P-core 6500P/6700P series (Granite Rapids), up to 86 cores, up to 350W

memory.notes: RDIMM 6400 MT/s at 1 DPC, 5200 at 2 DPC; MRDIMM up to 8000 MT/s (needs 6700P CPUs).

options: Front: 10x 2.5-inch NVMe or 16x E3.S
M.2 for OS boot
drives.notes: All-flash NVMe only: no 3.5-inch and no SAS/SATA data drives.

pcie.notes: All PCIe 5.0, all at the rear; 2 OCP 3.0 slots (x8 or x16).

psu.notes: 80 PLUS Platinum/Titanium; 800W, 1300W, 2000W AC. All support 230V, some also 115V; HVDC and -48V DC options exist.

notes: 1U appliance built on the SR630 V4.

Two-node clusters: guide limits storage to 20TB per node and notes limited-workload support.

machine_types.7DG4: CTO1 = HX650 V4 (all-flash), CTO2 = HX650 V4 Storage (storage-heavy hybrid)

platforms.cpu: Intel Xeon 6 P-core 6700P/6500P-series (Granite Rapids), up to 86 cores, up to 350W

memory.notes: RDIMM 6400 MT/s at 1 DPC, 5200 at 2 DPC; MRDIMM up to 8000 MT/s.

options: HX650 V4 (7DG4CTO1WW): front 16 or 24x 2.5-inch NVMe, no rear bays, no 3.5-inch
HX650 V4 Storage (7DG4CTO2WW): front 8x 3.5-inch SAS/SATA + 4x 3.5-inch AnyBay (12x 3.5-inch), rear 4x 2.5-inch (rear drive kit only with 10 or more HDDs)
Internal M.2 module (2 drives)
Guide notes: HDDs over 20TB are only for Nutanix Unified Storage use
drives.notes: 3.5-inch drives exist only on the Storage variant.

pcie.notes: All PCIe 5.0, all at the rear; risers 3 and 4 need 2 processors (so the full 10 slots need 2 CPUs); the Storage variant lists up to 9.

platforms.gpu: Up to 10x single-wide or 2x double-wide GPUs (all-flash model)
notes: The guide states HX650 V4 and HX650 V4 Storage each support 1 or 2 processors; an earlier revision listed the base model as 2-CPU only.
Nutanix capacity notes in the guide: per-node capacity over 307TB is only for Nutanix Unified Storage use (hybrid: 307TB to 550TB); a 2-node configuration is limited to 20TB per node.
